name: extract FSDI filtered
command: flock -s dumps/run-jfr-38/.matindex.lock java -Xmx3g -jar experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar mat-extract --hprof dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof --class org.gradle.api.internal.file.collections.FlatSourceDirectoriesImpl_Decorated --out /tmp/fsdi2.grph 2>&1 | grep -v "BFS:\|pass1:\|pass2:" | tail -8
description: extract FlatSourceDirectoriesImpl_Decorated with discovered filter under shared index lock
